lines.en: I move hovering above the ground.

lines.zh: 我的裙摆像薄翅一样张着
lines.en: My skirt spreads like thin wings.
I drift toward you.
My feet do not touch ground; it costs nothing.

lines.zh: 我从自己的蛋里孵出来时就认得你
lines.en: I knew you the moment I hatched.
I circle, looking for a position.
I always keep an arm's height above ground.

lines.zh: 草叶一响，我的高度就变。
lines.en: A blade of grass rustles, and my height changes.
My hem sweeps the grass tips.
I rise slowly.
I hover, ignoring everyone.

lines.zh: 你的影子在我下面缩成一团。
lines.en: Your shadow shrinks into a knot beneath me.
There is a faint light on me.

lines.zh: 一臂高的位置，我最自在。
lines.en: One arm's height above ground suits me best.

lines.zh: 我在想接下来该做什么
lines.en: I am considering what to do next.

lines.zh: 我的翅膀在背后慢慢扇
lines.en: My wings beat slowly behind me.

lines.zh: 这地方比我出生的巢大
lines.en: This place is bigger than the nest I hatched in.
I smooth my skirt.
I remember who my master is.
I usually hover higher than I speak.

lines.zh: 我在上方悬着，等一个空隙。
lines.en: Hovering above, I wait for a gap.
I hover very steadily.
I am counting the footsteps below.
My hem is still swaying slightly.
I dislike being too low.

lines.zh: 我的影子在地上一点点移
lines.en: My shadow creeps along the ground.
You are the one I chose.
I lower my head to you, a courtesy.

lines.zh: 你站在下面，我悬在上面
lines.en: You stand below; I hover above.

lines.zh: 我记得你打开蛋壳的声音
lines.en: I remember the sound of you opening the shell.

lines.zh: 你抬手，我就把高度降半臂。
lines.en: You raise a hand; I drop half an arm's height.
I am a little close to you.
Do you think I am too high?
I come down a little.
I am listening.

lines.zh: 你打开蛋壳时，手上有铁味。
lines.en: When you opened my shell, your hands smelled of iron.
I hover with my hem before your face.
I settle half an arm's length before you.
The blow knocked me lower.
My skirt is torn.
I drew back half an arm's length.
The light on my shoulder scatters.
I rise again.
I did not cry out.

lines.zh: 我朝你的方向看了一眼
lines.en: I glance your way.
I can still hover.
The light on me dimmed.

lines.zh: 我的光暗了半格，我升高些。
lines.en: My glow dims a notch; I rise a little.
I accept it, but it does not go in my mouth.
But if you offer it, I accept.
I hover and lay down my time field.
My hem touched it.
I am not good at refusing you.
This is somewhat sweet.
I tuck it into my sleeve.
The candy wrapper in your palm rustles.
I will remember the kindness.
Hold out your hand, and I will come down.
You hit my hem.

lines.zh: 气流把我推歪，我压回原位。
lines.en: The air pushes me askew; I settle back.
I rose a little to avoid you.
I am so light I cannot hurt you.
Do not grab my skirt.
I pass over your head.
Step back, and I will come down.

lines.zh: 你撞散了我的裙边，又合上。
lines.en: You scatter my skirt hem; it gathers again.
I am above you; you are below.
Let me pass.

lines.zh: 我是从你的蛋里出来的
lines.en: I came out of your egg.
Does that count as a bond?
I hover beside you.
My hands are very light.
We guard this nest together.
I do not need anyone else.
Look up and you will see me.

lines.zh: 我悬在你肩后，随时能落。
lines.en: I hover behind your shoulder, ready to land.
Lean on me when tired.
Do not stray far from this nest.
I hold it in my palm.

lines.zh: 我托着它，翅声轻了一半。
lines.en: I carry it and my wingbeat hushes.
I look at it, then put it away.
It glows a little.
I rise with it.
Is this important to you?
I will keep it for you.

lines.zh: 我悬在上方，等着布下时场。
lines.en: Hovering above, I prepare the time field.
I do not quite know how to use it.
I hold it in my palm for now.

lines.zh: 从上面看你，破绽一清二楚。
lines.en: From above, your openings are plain.

lines.zh: 我从上面看，什么都藏不住
lines.en: From above, nothing hides.
I descend slowly.

lines.zh: 你脚下的格子已经被我算好。
lines.en: I have already calculated the tile you stand on.
My skirt is beginning to glow.

lines.zh: 你已经在我算好的位置上。
lines.en: You are exactly where I calculated.

lines.zh: 我这一下会减速，也会很疼
lines.en: This will slow you, and it will hurt.
I can see every step you take.
You are going left; I calculated that.
I need not come close.
Then I will begin.
This is my master's enemy.
Then I will not be gentle.
In this instant.
I am above your head.

lines.zh: 你抬头看我，我就换位置
lines.en: When you look up, I move.

lines.zh: 我从女王的蛋里孵出来。
lines.en: I hatched from the queen's egg.

lines.zh: 我的减速弹已经凝好了
lines.en: My slowing shot is ready.
You are in the open; you cannot hide.
I swing around to your flank.
You retreat, and I match, keeping height.
My height is just right.

lines.zh: 你听见我裙摆的声音了吗
lines.en: Did you hear my skirt?

lines.zh: 减速弹在我掌心凝成一点。
lines.en: The slowing bolt beads in my palm.
This will land.
You are already slowing.
Shift a little nearer.
I see it perfectly clearly.
I will not miss.
Time runs slow around me.
I raise my hand; light falls.

lines.zh: 这一下会拖慢你的脚步
lines.en: This will slow your steps.
You are hit; your feet grow heavy.
I am above you; you cannot reach.
I pull back and gather the light again.
This is exactly what I waited for.
My hem sweeps your face.
It is not heavy, but it is unpleasant.
You raised your hand; I rise.
But I stand higher than you.
Then drop it once more.
This time you will be slowed longer.
You can no longer see me clearly.
That is sufficient.
The shell cracks first.

lines.zh: 我挣开湿壳，先找你的脸。
lines.en: I break the wet shell and look for your face.
The first thing I do is look for you.
I rise, taller than you.
My skirt spreads open.
I have chosen you.

lines.zh: 蛋壳里出来，我先绕一圈。
lines.en: Fresh from the egg, I circle once first.

lines.zh: 孵出来的第一眼，是这间屋子。
lines.en: The first thing I saw was this room.
Eggshell still clings to my skirt hem.
And take off again at once.

lines.zh: 我记得刚出生时看到的第一个东西
lines.en: I remember the first thing I saw.
That one is you.

lines.zh: 我会悬在你上方，挡着落石。
lines.en: I will hover above you and block the falling stones.
Unless you tell me to stay.
I do not yet have a name.
Will you give me one?
I will hover and wait.
This nest is ours.
I will always be above.
Watching the surroundings for you.
The edge of my skirt curls in the flame.

lines.zh: 裙摆挂住树枝，我才没落地。
lines.en: My hem caught a branch, or I would have hit the ground.
My wings are wet; I sink.
The blast throws me far.

lines.zh: 箭尾还在晃，我的裙摆一沉。
lines.en: The arrow still quivers; my skirt dips.

lines.zh: 那道光照得我裙摆全亮
lines.en: That light makes my whole skirt glow.
I have not eaten in so long.
Lightning runs along my skirt.
There is no up or down here.
